hook.en: A plate of nasi lemak takes about 24–72 hours to travel through 9 metres of your digestive tract. Along the way it's chewed, churned, dissolved by acid and enzymes, absorbed — and finally the leftovers leave.
hook.bm: Sepinggan nasi lemak mengambil masa kira-kira 24–72 jam untuk melalui 9 meter salur pencernaan anda. Dalam perjalanan ia dikunyah, dikisar, dilarutkan oleh asid dan enzim, diserap — dan akhirnya sisanya dikeluarkan.

bigIdeas.en: Digestion breaks large food molecules into small soluble ones the body can absorb.
bigIdeas.bm: Pencernaan memecahkan molekul makanan besar kepada molekul kecil terlarut yang boleh diserap badan.

bigIdeas.en: Villi in the small intestine absorb nutrients into blood and lymph.
bigIdeas.bm: Vilus dalam usus kecil menyerap nutrien ke dalam darah dan limfa.

bigIdeas.en: Assimilation uses nutrients in cells; defecation removes undigested waste.
bigIdeas.bm: Asimilasi menggunakan nutrien dalam sel; penyahtinjaan menyingkir sisa tidak tercerna.

bigIdeas.en: A balanced diet prevents diseases like obesity, diabetes and gastritis.
bigIdeas.bm: Gizi seimbang mencegah penyakit seperti obesiti, diabetes dan gastritis.

definition.en: Breaking down complex food into simple soluble molecules.
definition.bm: Penguraian makanan kompleks kepada molekul ringkas terlarut.

definition.en: Wave-like muscle contractions that push food along the gut.
definition.bm: Pengecutan otot seperti gelombang yang menolak makanan sepanjang salur.

definition.en: Made in the liver; emulsifies fats and neutralises stomach acid.
definition.bm: Dihasilkan oleh hati; mengemulsikan lemak dan meneutralkan asid perut.

definition.en: Finger-like projection of the ileum wall that absorbs digested food.
definition.bm: Unjuran seperti jari pada dinding ileum yang menyerap makanan tercerna.

definition.en: Lymph vessel in a villus that absorbs fatty acids and glycerol.
definition.bm: Salur limfa dalam vilus yang menyerap asid lemak dan gliserol.

definition.en: Using absorbed nutrients to build or fuel cells.
definition.bm: Menggunakan nutrien yang diserap untuk membina atau membekalkan tenaga kepada sel.

definition.en: All food classes in the right proportions for a person's needs.
definition.bm: Semua kelas makanan dalam kadar yang betul mengikut keperluan seseorang.

question.en: Trace the digestion of a protein from egg white to amino acids.
question.bm: Jejak pencernaan protein putih telur hingga asid amino.

steps.en: Stomach: pepsin (pH 2) hydrolyses protein → polypeptides. Rennin coagulates milk protein (in babies).
steps.bm: Perut: pepsin (pH 2) menghidrolisis protein → polipeptida. Renin mengentalkan protein susu (pada bayi).

steps.en: Duodenum: trypsin from the pancreas (pH 8) → polypeptides into peptides.
steps.bm: Duodenum: tripsin dari pankreas (pH 8) → polipeptida kepada peptida.

steps.en: Ileum: erepsin (peptidase) → peptides into amino acids.
steps.bm: Ileum: erepsin (peptidase) → peptida kepada asid amino.

steps.en: Amino acids are absorbed into blood capillaries of the villi.
steps.bm: Asid amino diserap ke dalam kapilari darah vilus.

answer.en: Pepsin → trypsin → erepsin; amino acids absorbed into the blood.
answer.bm: Pepsin → tripsin → erepsin; asid amino diserap ke dalam darah.

prompt.en: Arrange the parts of the digestive tract in the order food passes through.
prompt.bm: Susun bahagian salur pencernaan mengikut urutan makanan melaluinya.

explanation.en: The liver, gall bladder and pancreas are accessory organs — food doesn't pass through them.
explanation.bm: Hati, pundi hempedu dan pankreas ialah organ aksesori — makanan tidak melaluinya.

prompt.en: Match each enzyme to what it digests.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap enzim dengan apa yang dicernakannya.

explanation.en: Final products: glucose, amino acids, fatty acids and glycerol.
explanation.bm: Hasil akhir: glukosa, asid amino, asid lemak dan gliserol.

prompt.en: What is the role of bile in digestion?

explanation.en: Bile has no enzymes; it increases the surface area of fats for lipase and neutralises acidic chyme.
explanation.bm: Hempedu tiada enzim; ia menambah luas permukaan lemak untuk lipase dan meneutralkan kim berasid.

prompt.en: Why does the stomach secrete hydrochloric acid?

options.en: To give pepsin its optimum pH and kill bacteria
options.bm: Untuk memberi pH optimum kepada pepsin dan membunuh bakteria

explanation.en: pH about 2 activates pepsin and kills most microorganisms in food.
explanation.bm: pH kira-kira 2 mengaktifkan pepsin dan membunuh kebanyakan mikroorganisma dalam makanan.

prompt.en: Select ALL adaptations of the villi for absorption.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA penyesuaian vilus untuk penyerapan.

options.en: Covered in a thick layer of cartilage

explanation.en: Each villus also has a lacteal to absorb fatty acids and glycerol.
explanation.bm: Setiap vilus juga mempunyai lakteal untuk menyerap asid lemak dan gliserol.

prompt.en: Fatty acids and glycerol are absorbed into the…
prompt.bm: Asid lemak dan gliserol diserap ke dalam…

explanation.en: They form tiny fat droplets and enter the lymphatic system via the lacteal.
explanation.bm: Ia membentuk titisan lemak kecil dan memasuki sistem limfa melalui lakteal.

prompt.en: What happens to excess amino acids in the liver?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang berlaku kepada asid amino berlebihan dalam hati?

options.en: Stored as protein in the liver

explanation.en: The body can't store amino acids; the amino group becomes urea, excreted by the kidneys.
explanation.bm: Badan tidak boleh menyimpan asid amino; kumpulan amino menjadi urea yang dikumuh oleh ginjal.

prompt.en: A diet low in fibre often leads to…

explanation.en: Fibre adds bulk and stimulates peristalsis, helping defecation.
explanation.bm: Serat menambah pukal dan merangsang peristalsis, membantu penyahtinjaan.

prompt.en: Match each deficiency to the disease.

explanation.en: A balanced diet includes all seven classes: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water.
explanation.bm: Gizi seimbang merangkumi tujuh kelas: karbohidrat, protein, lemak, vitamin, mineral, serat dan air.

prompt.en: Why can skipping meals lead to gastritis?
prompt.bm: Mengapa melangkau waktu makan boleh menyebabkan gastritis?

options.en: Acid continues to be secreted and irritates the empty stomach lining
options.bm: Asid terus dirembes dan merengsa dinding perut yang kosong

explanation.en: Regular meals, less spicy food and stress management help prevent gastritis. Helicobacter pylori infection is another cause.
explanation.bm: Makan berkala, kurangkan makanan pedas dan mengurus tekanan membantu mencegah gastritis. Jangkitan Helicobacter pylori juga penyebabnya.
